The exact scorer is not the cause of low recall. Independent reimplementation of normalization reproduces every normalized_output and exact_recall label. It correctly rejects empty strings and accepts only the full target code after bounded punctuation/code-fence stripping; no incidental substring, last-number extraction or near-label decoy is accepted. Independent pair joining reproduces paired_metrics.json exactly with 24 matched cases and no missing or duplicate case.

The dominant failure is a generation-harness failure shared by both cache arms. Forty of 48 /completion responses are HTTP 200 but contain an empty content string, stop_type=eos, predicted_n=1 and predicted_ms=0.001. This pattern occurs in all F16 and Q8 start/middle cases, all 8k end cases, and leaves only the eight 16k/end cases nonempty and correct. Each arm therefore scores 4/24=0.1666667 recall for the same positional pattern. HTTP success alone is a false-negative integrity criterion here because it treats immediate empty EOS as a valid scientific response.

The throughput gate is a false positive of the same harness defect. The runner converts each degenerate one-token/0.001-ms record into 1,000,000 tokens/s; because 20 of 24 records in each arm are degenerate, both medians become 1,000,000 and their ratio becomes exactly 1.0. This number is physically meaningless and cannot support throughput non-regression. As a non-gating diagnostic only, the four nonempty 16k/end outputs have F16 median 71.886 tokens/s and Q8 median 67.081 tokens/s, ratio 0.933; outcome-conditioned filtering is not preregistered and must not replace a fresh valid run.

The paired bootstrap is mechanically correct but scientifically non-informative. All 24 paired correctness differences are zero because both arms fail and succeed on exactly the same cases. A clean-room 20,000-replicate bootstrap with seed 2026082823 reproduces point and percentile interval [0,0], with sorted replicate-vector SHA-256 7bc688b4561572ea8ceecc0e74d165970c37f4ba42db457028c3d570340bedf0. Equal failure does not establish usable noninferiority when both preregistered absolute-recall gates fail by 78.3 percentage points.

The result is not evidence of a Q8-specific long-context defect or inferiority. F16 and Q8 have identical casewise correctness and output patterns, and the observed collapse aligns with use of the raw /completion endpoint against an instruction-tuned model whose serving chat template is not applied to the supplied archive as a user message. The isolated recovery at 16k/end further shows that the model/runtime can emit the target under the same scorer, while the immediate EOS pattern invalidates arm attribution.

The physical memory observation independently recomputes: F16 block-start memory values 21,606 and 21,632 MiB give median 21,619; Q8 values 20,760 and 20,760 MiB give median 20,760; the global same-host saving is 859 MiB. This satisfies its frozen gate as a coarse block-level artifact, not per-process attribution, and cannot rescue the failed retrieval experiment. No concurrency capacity follows from this single-slot memory difference.
